## Safety

- **Do not force-push `main`**, skip hooks, or invent demo auth bypasses.

## Response style: terse by default

The owner scans many terminals — optimize for fast scanning, not completeness.

- **Cut the recap.** One line per real decision or blocker; gates as a single line (`tsc ✅ · jest 462 ✅ · not committed`). Don't restate the task or list files unless asked.
- **Expand only on request** ("why" / "expand" / "show the diff").

## What this repo is

A pnpm + Turborepo monorepo that ships a paid starter kit for non-technical builders. Two kinds
of code, governed by the **Owned vs Maintained** split (see `CONTEXT.md`):

- `packages/*` — **MAINTAINED**, headless, `private: true` — **never** published to npm (ADR-0033).
  They ship bundled inside the `vybekiit` CLI (the only public artifact) and are consumed via the
  workspace in the gated monorepo clone. Buyers never edit these. No UI, no framework lock — pure TS.
- `templates/*` — **OWNED**, not published, copied into the buyer's own repo by the CLI. Includes
  all UI and the buyer-facing agent layer. Treated as the buyer's code the moment it's scaffolded.

When you add code, first decide which bucket it belongs to. Logic the buyer shouldn't touch →
`packages/`. Anything they'll customize (UI, screens, copy, their app shell) → `templates/`.

## Stack & tooling

- **Language:** TypeScript, strict. No `any`; narrow in `catch` (`instanceof Error`) before use.
- **Monorepo:** pnpm workspaces + Turborepo. Only the `vybekiit` CLI publishes to npm (MIT, ADR-0033); every `packages/*` is `private: true`.
- **Web/extension UI:** shadcn/ui. **Mobile UI:** plain StyleSheet primitives + `@vybekiit/tokens`.
- **Infra the templates target:** Cloudflare (host/edge/cron/storage/email) + Supabase (db/auth).
- **Payments:** one `@vybekiit/payments` package, one payment service contract, provider adapters
  under `providers/{lemon-squeezy,stripe,paypal}` (official SDKs). Lemon Squeezy is the v1 default
  (Merchant of Record); the agent swaps providers via the `PAYMENTS_PROVIDER` env.

# AGENTS.md instructions for [PATH]/Code/Oly-App

<INSTRUCTIONS>
# Oly-App

Agent contract for this repo. **Normative** for coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Claude via adapter, Gemini via adapter, etc.). Long-form rationale lives in `docs/adr/`.

## Source-of-truth map

| Doc | Role |
| --- | --- |
| **This file (`AGENTS.md`)** | Always-on agent contract (digest + gates + safety) — SSOT for Codex, Cursor, Kiro, Roo, and other AGENTS-aware tools |
| [`CLAUDE.md`](./CLAUDE.md) | Claude Code adapter only — imports this file via `@AGENTS.md`; does not restate the contract |
| [`GEMINI.md`](./GEMINI.md) | Gemini CLI adapter only — imports this file via `@./AGENTS.md`; does not restate the contract |
| [`CODE-STYLE.md`](./CODE-STYLE.md) | How to write code — full rules, ✓/✗, golden path, Never list (`deslop` reads per-diff) |
| [`code-style.rules.json`](./code-style.rules.json) | Machine index of `CODE-STYLE.md` — channels + exemplars the code-style coach reads (derived; **not** a second source of truth) |
| [`CONTEXT.md`](./CONTEXT.md) | Orientation — what it is, actors, shape |
| [`LANGUAGE.md`](./LANGUAGE.md) | Domain glossary (term → definition + aliases) |
| [`PROJECT.md`](./PROJECT.md) | Purpose & direction |
| [`docs/adr/`](./docs/adr/) | Numbered decisions |
| [`docs/deslop/`](./docs/deslop/) | Folder-by-folder de-slop execution plans (src done; services/infra next) |
| [`README.md`](./README.md) | Humans — setup, stack, running the app |
| [`TEACH.md`](./TEACH.md) | Onboarding — plain-English stack + architecture tour (teaches; **not** normative — the rows above win) |

**Edit style rules in `CODE-STYLE.md`, not here.** This file only digests what agents must hold every session.

**Tool adapters** — keep thin. Do **not** clone this guide into `.cursor/rules`, `.claude/rules`, `.kiro/steering`, `.roo/rules`, or `.github/copilot-instructions.md` unless a path- or tool-specific rule is genuinely required.

## Read order (new work)

1. This file → 2. `CODE-STYLE.md` (golden path + Never for the unit) → 3. `CONTEXT.md` / `LANGUAGE.md` if domain terms → 4. relevant ADR → 5. code.

## Setup & verify

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck          # app + lambdas + cdk + scripts
pnpm test                   # jest
pnpm run lint               # biome
pnpm run lint:contracts     # named-function, TSDoc, type, and test contracts
pnpm run lint:source-policy
pnpm run doctor:score       # React UI: must be 100 before TestFlight/release
pnpm run cli                # interactive ops (TTY); agents prefer pnpm run <verb:noun>
```

Script-only: `pnpm run typecheck:scripts`. Full typecheck when touching `runtime/`.

## Safety

- **No secrets in logs, commits, or client bundles** — server env via Schema; never log tokens/PII.
- **Authed-by-default** — Express middleware denies by default; public paths are an explicit allowlist; `sub` comes from verified request auth, not the body.
- **No `.xlsx` / exceljs** — permanently retired (ADR 0045).
- **Production-ready only** — client export + Lambda + IAM + CDK in the same change; no half-built routes.
- **Do not force-push `main`**, skip hooks, or invent demo auth bypasses.

## Response style: terse by default

The owner scans many terminals — optimize for fast scanning, not completeness.

- **Outcome first, ≤6 lines.** First line = what changed / the answer; no preamble or postamble. Don't narrate steps already visible in tool calls.
- **Cut the recap.** One line per real decision or blocker; gates as a single line (`tsc ✅ · jest 462 ✅ · not committed`). Don't restate the task or list files unless asked.
- **Expand only on request** ("why" / "expand" / "show the diff").

## Naming conventions

## Goal
On `/app/admin/users` (`AdminUsersAnalytics`), pressing a focused data-menu row on charts must open a modal listing the underlying records (users/visits), matching home activity drilldown UX (`AdminHomeAnalyticsSections` + `ActivityChartDetailModal` + `adminOverviewActivityDetails`).

- Funnel chart: metric for full selected range.
- Sources chart: metric=visitors (or best-fit) + optional `source` query matching breakdown key.

- Do NOT implement affiliates or whatsapp.

9. i18n en+he keys under admin.analytics.* for details title/count/empty if needed (reuse admin.charts.* where they fit).
10. Unit test server details filtering at least one metric (spec colocated).

## Style
Follow Agents.md / CODE-STYLE: no `??` / `||` defaults for domain state; explicit undefined checks; named arrow exports; no feature→feature imports.

## Verify before done
- `npm run typecheck --workspace=@mypr/server` and `@mypr/client` (or focused tsc if faster)
- `npm run style:code` or biome on touched files
- focused server test for getDetails

List files changed, API shape, what charts wired, any intentional skips.

# Phase 1: Native Amplitude + platform-neutral consent (MYPR)

You implement **exactly** Phase 1 of the native analytics plan. Work in the existing workspace at `[PATH]/Code/MYPR-App`. Do not merge `_layout.tsx` / `_layout.web.tsx`. Do not implement Firebase/GA native (another agent owns that). Do not implement Session Replay on native. Do not invent env secrets from `.env` contents into commits or logs.

## Product rules (must follow)

### Consent matrix for Amplitude native (align PostHog native)

| Stored consent | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `granted` | init / opt in |
| `denied` | `setOptOut(true)` / do not capture |
| **unset** | **opt in** on native (same as PostHog native today) |

### Web Amplitude (must not regress)

Web continues to require **`granted`** before init (current `amplitude.ts` behavior with `@amplitude/unified` + Session Replay). Tests in `amplitude.spec.ts` currently assert web behavior (no init when unset) — after split, web tests stay on the web module.

### No IDFA / ATT

Disable advertising id tracking options on native Amplitude. Do not add ATT strings.

## Current state (read these first)

- `client/src/analytics/amplitude.ts` — browser `@amplitude/unified` only; `typeof window === 'undefined'` early returns
- `client/src/analytics/AmplitudeHost.tsx` — native no-op stub
- `client/src/analytics/AmplitudeHost.web.tsx` — boots + consent listener
- `client/src/analytics/acquisitionAttribution.ts` — `bindAnalyticsConsentListener` is **web-only** (`window` CustomEvent); native hosts cannot hear consent changes
- `client/src/analytics/posthog.ts` — native unset → opt in pattern to mirror
- `client/app/_layout.tsx` already mounts `<AmplitudeHost />`
- Env: `EXPO_PUBLIC_AMPLITUDE_API_KEY` via `clientRuntimeConfig.amplitudeApiKey`
- AsyncStorage already installed
- CODE-STYLE: follow `CODE-STYLE.md` / Agents.md — no unnecessary abstractions; platform extensions over huge Platform.OS branches where Metro already does that

## Implementation checklist

### 1. Platform-neutral consent notification

Update `acquisitionAttribution.ts` so consent changes notify listeners on **native and web**:

- Keep existing web CustomEvent for banner / prefs
- Add a small in-memory subscriber list that `saveAnalyticsConsent` always notifies
- `bindAnalyticsConsentListener` registers the in-memory listener (and still attaches window listener on web for any other CustomEvent dispatchers)
- Preserve AsyncStorage keys and APIs (`readAnalyticsConsent`, `saveAnalyticsConsent`, events constants)
- Extend `acquisitionAttribution.spec.ts` if present for listener behavior

### 2. Split Amplitude modules

- **`amplitude.web.ts`**: move current browser implementation (`@amplitude/unified`, Session Replay, **requires granted**)
- **`amplitude.ts`** (native default): implement with `@amplitude/analytics-react-native`:
  - Install: from `client/`, `npx expo install @amplitude/analytics-react-native` (AsyncStorage already present)
  - Export same public API used by hosts/tests: `initAmplitude`, `denyAmplitude`, `applyAmplitudeConsent`
  - Consent: denied → no capture; **unset OR granted → allow** (native)
  - Init with `optOut: false` when allowed; use `setOptOut` for deny/re-enable
  - `disableCookies: true` where applicable
  - `trackingOptions`: disable `adid` (and do not enable IDFA paths)
  - `trackingSessionEvents: true` preferred
  - Missing API key → warn via existing logger, return false (like web)
  - Safe if double-called
  - Analytics must never throw into product UI

Metro resolution: `.web.ts` for web, `.ts` for native. Ensure web tests import the web module path or configure so vitest exercises web rules correctly.

### 3. Implement `AmplitudeHost.tsx` (native)

Mirror `AmplitudeHost.web.tsx` structure:

- On mount: `initAmplitude()` (which respects native unset→on policy)
- `bindAnalyticsConsentListener` → `applyAmplitudeConsent`
- Never throw; catch and swallow
- Return `undefined` / null UI

Keep `AmplitudeHost.web.tsx` working
